newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks sink in late trade on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks sink in late trade on profit-taking.

text.p: Taiwan share prices sank in late trade on Thursday, with investors taking profits against five straight sessions of gains, brokers said.
With 45 minutes left at 0315 GMT, the weighted index was down 36.23 points or 0.44 percent at 8,246.68.
Turnover was an active T$95.81 billion.
The market had opened higher on news that the central bank and the Securities and Exchange Commission had agreed to speed up screening and approval procedures on foreign equity funds.
"It is time for the market to take a breather," said Oliver Fang, senior analyst for National Securities.
Electronics, which had spearheaded the index's recent rise, lost 0.43 percent, echoing declines by high-tech firms on Wall Street.
